CONTEXT_CLASSIFICATION.context_at_time_of_insight: User required a proper architectural and optimized solution to eliminate IPC stalling and token waste during job discovery.

psychological_state.decision_style: User demanded an optimized system architecture where the scripts act only as arms, gathering data and returning it in a single batch to the brain to save tokens and time.

interaction_pairing.user_action: Reported that the agent stalled, finding 0 applications in 4 hours due to serial IPC blocking.
interaction_pairing.ai_response_quality: High. Successfully implemented Batch Architecture v2.0 (ARM->BRAIN->EXECUTE).
interaction_pairing.friction_points: Legacy DAEMON_MODE logic completely bypassed AI evaluation. Scripts were polling per-card.
interaction_pairing.resolution: Decoupled scraping from evaluation. Evaluates 50 cards at once via batch_question.json.

cognitive_evolution.new_pattern_detected: The agent must now evaluate all job cards in a single batch file (batch_question.json) rather than serially (pending_question.json).
cognitive_evolution.changed_from_prior_belief: Serial 90-second wait per card is an anti-pattern. Batch processing is the standard.
cognitive_evolution.consistency_with_axioms: Agent must act as the primary intelligence (brain) while scripts act merely as sensory appendages (arms).

long_term_application.future_implication: All future discovery logic must use the SearchStateManager rotation engine and Batch IPC to maintain pipeline flow without starvation.
long_term_application.cross_project_note: Batch evaluation over serial evaluation is a universal optimization for autonomous loops.
